summary: No mathematical errors or gaps found. Exact checks of the smallest admissible graphs, bridges, disconnected components, and strongly biased tilts found no counterexample. The incidence rank, TU lattice chart, closed-halfspace boundary treatment, predecessor aliases and probability normalizations, auxiliary gauge, cloning identity, and componentwise factor are valid. The retrieved arXiv:0711.3496v2 confirms Corollary 2.5 with all required hypotheses satisfied. The factorial envelope and exact threshold certificate establish the uniform dense-graph bound, and the capacity scaling and root-depth conclusions follow as stated.
